items.title: What Does PI Add to OPSD?
items.description: 2026.09 NUS arXiv 2609.20612 What Does Privileged Information Add to On-Policy Self-Distillation?: builds AMPLE-Math (5,319 problems × six reasoning views sharing one answer) and compares each view against matched reference-free distillation. Reference-free distillation accounts for much of Qwen3-1.7B's gain, and the reference adds a modest, model-dependent extra. Swapping short direct-response rollouts for long thinking rollouts turns gains into losses. Concludes that OPSD mostly unlocks cross-mode (thinking → direct) transfer. Joins the negative-PI line (Rethinking Privileged Information, OP²SD, Fin-SD ablations)

items.title: One-Shot OPD
items.description: 2026.09 Tsinghua / UCAS / Northeastern / UIUC / JHU arXiv 2609.04172 Rethinking OPD of LLMs II: One Training Example: OPD on a single query keeps improving for hundreds of steps and recovers most of full-data OPD's gain. One query already reaches 71.5% state coverage of what full-data OPD visits, and 16 diverse queries reach 98.9% and match full data, including for MOPD. Alignment slows at the same rate regardless of data, so OPD is "data-overfed but algorithm-starved". Sequel to Rethinking OPD (THUNLP)

repo_info.description: Rethinking On-Policy Distillation of Large Language Models II: One Training Example

items.title: DF-OPD
items.description: 2026.09 Tencent (Foundation Model Dept.) / CASIA / UCAS arXiv 2609.14193 Data-Free OPD: How Far Can We Go Without External Data?: 8 real prompts ≈ 17k problems in two single-teacher OPD settings, and difficulty or initial gap barely matter. With 64 self-generated questions (no seed examples), DF-OPD matches full-data OPD, and in multi-teacher OPD 1k generated questions ≈ 7k real ones. Independently reaches the same data-minimal conclusion as One-Shot OPD

items.title: OPD Vanishing Signals
items.description: 2026.10 UPenn / Tsinghua / UC Riverside / Marquette arXiv 2610.11247 Why On-Policy Distillation Sometimes Fails: Vanishing Learning Signals — Continuous-time dynamical analysis of OPD failures on code and math. OPD with larger teachers plateaus (average final loss reduction 25.1% vs 96.2% for self-RL teachers), associated with an early decline in a learning-signal proxy. Includes a local recovery guarantee for teachers close to the student.

repo_info.description: Code and reproducibility artifacts for Why On-Policy Distillation Sometimes Fails: Vanishing Learning Signals

items.title: Does SD Improve Reasoning?
items.description: 2026.10 MIT / MIT-IBM Computing Research Lab arXiv 2610.18613 Does self-distillation improve reasoning? — Re-evaluates SDPO and OPSD on code, science, tool use and math with Qwen3 1.7B-14B and OLMo-3-7B. Reported gains do not consistently generalise to unseen problems and are largely explained by overfitting or transferred thinking behaviour rather than privileged information. Self-distillation gradients align weakly with policy gradients.

items.title: OPDArena
items.description: 2026.10 Microsoft Research / Nankai arXiv 2610.25651 OPDArena: Understanding Learning and Forgetting in On-Policy Distillation — Framework comparing SFT, RLVR and OPD across five models and varied teacher sources on math learning, capability retention and distribution change. Students of RLVR-trained teachers improve on the target task while retaining prior capabilities, whereas SFT-trained teachers cause greater loss. OOD distribution change tracks forgetting more consistently than in-domain change.

repo_info.description: OPDArena: training and evaluation for learning and forgetting in on-policy distillation

items.title: ESC
items.description: 2026.10 Simon Fraser / Borealis AI arXiv 2610.39020 Distilling the Shape of Uncertainty: What On-Policy Distillation Learns and How to Predict It — Shows OPD learns where to branch (entropy shape) as well as how to branch. Introduces Entropy Shape Correlation and uses causal interventions on teacher entropy. Where to branch causally drives OPD gains; pre-OPD ESC picks the best teacher, outperforming existing predictors.

items.title: EP-OPD
items.description: 2026.11 Yale NLP Lab arXiv 2611.01967 Better Answers, Weaker Evidence Control: Evidence Bypass in On-Policy Distillation — Finds OPD improves answers but weakens evidence responsiveness. On QASPER, standard OPD gives +3.4pp original accuracy, -5.3pp counterfactual accuracy and +15.7pp bypass. Supplying the teacher with answer-critical spans helps most. The proposed EP-OPD recovers 54-66% of the counterfactual loss.

items.title: OPD Mismatch Budget
items.description: 2026.11 Aalto / NTU / BIT / Cambridge / SZUAT arXiv 2611.11450 How Much Training-Inference Mismatch Can On-Policy Distillation Tolerate? — Measures how much quantization, weight staleness and noise mismatch OPD tolerates, giving an empirical mismatch budget and a lightweight admission check. OPD stays stable where RL destabilises. FP8 plus async rollouts reaches the same quality 1.62x sooner than sync BF16.

items.title: ATI-OPD
items.description: 2026.10 Huawei / Harbin Institute of Technology arXiv 2610.38160 ATI-OPD: Adaptive Teacher Intervention for Stable Long-Sequence On-Policy Distillation — The student rolls out and the teacher scores it in 128-token segments. The earliest high-divergence segment is replaced by a short teacher segment and the student resumes. Persistently divergent suffixes are masked from the loss. Higher student-only accuracy than OPD on five math benchmarks and two teacher-student pairs (e.g. 39.65 vs 38.45 avg), with fewer gradient spikes.

items.title: Bernoulli OPD
items.description: 2026.11 University of Surrey / UCL / ELLIS Institute Tübingen / MPI-IS / Tübingen AI Center arXiv 2611.02093 Bernoulli On-Policy Distillation: Don't Ignore High-Confidence Student Tokens — Sampled reverse-KL OPD damps updates on tokens the student is already confident about. Bernoulli OPD treats each sampled token as a binary prediction and matches student and teacher probabilities (gradient p_S - p_T), which restores signal there. Qwen3-4B-Instruct to Qwen3-1.7B: 5-benchmark average rises from 44.38 (vanilla OPD).

items.title: GIFT

Each token's distillation gradient is split into a part parallel to the RL gradient (conflict) and an orthogonal part (value), and tokens are ranked on that split. Coverage is annealed to zero, ending at pure GRPO. Up to 9.5% relative gain on hard math reasoning.

items.title: 🤝 OPD-RL Hybrids — Inside-RL OPD

items.description:
Genuine OPD work on math / code / long-CoT reasoning. Off-policy SFT-distill from R1, pure RL methods (Skywork-OR1, SimpleRL-Zoo, Time-R1), and analysis-only papers are excluded from this list — each had no student-rollout-with-teacher-supervision component.
The reasoning-OPD canon already lives across OPSD (siyan-zhao/OPSD, CRISP, SD-Zero), Iterative Self-Bootstrapping (rStar / rStar-Math), OPD-RL Hybrids (LUFFY, RLAD, KDRL, RLSD, HDPO), and White-Box (REOPOLD, Fast OPD, Entropy-Aware OPD, TIP, SCOPE, PACED). This section only lists items not already covered above.

The log-prob contrast defines a reward that tilts the teacher distribution for reverse-KL distillation, so the student learns to rely on acoustic evidence rather than textual shortcuts. Beats vanilla OPD on all 3 benchmarks; 3B student reaches 72.72% MMAU. The audio counterpart of OPD-Aha / VCSD

items.title: S-OPD
items.description: 2026.09 Nanjing Univ. / Fudan / NUPT arXiv 2609.39120 Is Better Teacher Supervision Enough? Unlocking Student-side Learning in Multimodal On-Policy Distillation: adds two student-side terms to sampled-token OPD. A teacher-calibrated policy contrast pushes the student's prediction on the image away from its prediction on a randomly masked copy, only at the tokens whose teacher log-probability drops under the same mask; a policy agreement term pulls it toward its prediction on a Gaussian-noised copy. Qwen3-VL-2B / 4B students with an 8B (or GRPO-trained 8B) teacher on ViRL39K

items.description: 2026.10 Zhejiang Univ arXiv 2610.12355 Distilling Routed 3D Privilege for Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models — Geometry-Privileged Distillation makes question-routed depth, semantic and BEV cues (rendered as text) plus the reference answer the privilege for a same-model OPSD teacher. A privileged KL on incorrect student rollouts is added to GRPO, and the deployed model is RGB-only. 4B model reaches 57.1 on VSI-Bench and 37.6 average on four other spatial benchmarks, beating GRPO and answer-only OPSD.

items.title: CV-OPD
items.description: 2026.10 Xiamen Univ / Moxin Technology arXiv 2610.13264 CV-OPD: Contrastive Vision On-policy Distillation — Answer-hinted OPD lets VLMs answer correctly even with the relevant visual regions masked, a shortcut. CV-OPD contrasts teacher distributions from positive and negative crops on the same student prefix, adds a margin-based contrastive divergence loss and a discrepancy-aware gate over tokens and samples. Reduces the shortcut and consistently improves fine-grained visual benchmarks.

items.title: OPD Inherits the Teacher
items.description: 2026.10 Georgia Tech arXiv 2610.20989 Do As I Do, Not As I Say: On-Policy Distillation Inherits the Teacher in Vision-Language Models — Controlled comparison of OPD and filtered SFT for VLMs. OPD works only when the teacher stays reliable on student-generated trajectories. On Geometry3K, where the teacher fails to complete 22% of solutions, OPD trails SFT by 7.9 points, and OPD from an SFT start cuts completion from 76% to 62%. On ChartQA, OPD on 10% of the data comes within 1.4 points of full-data SFT.

items.title: SCOPED

items.title: NLD-Uni
items.description: 2026.10 NVIDIA arXiv 2610.36466 Nemotron-Labs-Diffusion-Uni: Elastic Self-Refining Unified Diffusion LLM with Cross-Paradigm On-Policy Distillation — Cross-paradigm OPD transfers AR-VLM understanding and flow-model generation into one unified discrete-diffusion LLM, supervising the student's AR view on its own rollouts plus a self-consistency loss for the diffusion view.
